name: @caravan/ledger
description: A narrowly scoped browser primitive for preparing Ledger devices for Caravan

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:private && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:package:built && npm run test:documentation:built && npm run test:ledger-contract:guard
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser-synthetic && npm run test:browser-build
scripts.test:consumer: npm run build && npm run test:consumer:built
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run src test/handoff test/model test/privacy test/browser-lab --coverage --coverage.thresholds.branches=95
scripts.test:documentation: npm run build && npm run test:documentation:built
scripts.test:package: npm run build && npm run test:package:built
scripts.test:package:built: node test/import-built.mjs && node test/artifact-contract.mjs && npm run test:consumer:built
scripts.test:private: npm run test:model && npm run test:privacy && npm run test:handoff && npm run test:browser

author: Caravan
